title: triteleia crocea var. modesta
intro: Triteleia crocea var. modesta, commonly known as the Modest or Yellow Bells, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic and antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Triteleia crocea var. modesta include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
